jobs.objective: PROPOSE the falsifiable RFC 0052 design SPEC: a committee deliberation workflow SHAPE — N producer roles deliberate to convergence under a named arbitrator, with typed front-mattered durable debate-turn artifacts, before a downstream consumer reads their output. Read the v1 SEED and RFC 0052 in full first. The RFC targets two costs the dogfood ledger surfaces: ITERATION LATENCY (every disagreement is an artifact round-trip publish->claim->ack->read->verdict) and REVIEWER CO-BLINDNESS (D095-D102: same-lane implementer+reviewer share blind spots and rubber-stamp; cross-lane posture-mismatch treats real findings as baseline) — solved by LANE COMPOSITION, not posture labels (RFC 0018). Harden as FALSIFIABLE assertions + tests: (1) the committee SHAPE as a generatable workflow shape (like the existing falsification_gate/implementation_panel/cross_examination shapes in the catalog) — its jobs/edges/phases/roles, how debate turns are typed front-mattered durable artifacts (a new artifact_kind?), how it composes on the existing workflow.v1.1 schema + the daemon RPC the shape compiles to; (2) the ARBITRATOR role with BOUNDED authority — record consensus / escalate to a panel / declare stalemate / sustain or end deliberation — define its authority precisely so it cannot over-reach (arbitrator capture) and deliberation provably TERMINATES (no infinite debate; a turn/round bound); (3) co-blindness solved by lane composition — the shape must structurally prevent same-lane producer+arbitrator and ensure cross-model diversity. ANCHOR to the real shape-generation machinery (striatum workflow templates / the shape catalog), the workflow.v1.1 schema, and the daemon mutation registry. Note this is DEFERRED/UNSCHEDULED (D225) — the maintainer re-confirmed it's wanted by launching this run; scope a P0 that proves the shape end-to-end. Define the P0 slice. This is the published claim the falsifiers re-attack.
jobs.title: Hold leading proposal

jobs.objective: Read the published holder SPEC and RFC 0052. Your lens is SHAPE SOUNDNESS + TERMINATION + ARBITRATOR AUTHORITY. Attack: does the committee shape actually TERMINATE — is there a hard turn/round bound, or can deliberation loop forever (two producers never converging, the arbitrator never declaring stalemate)? Is the arbitrator's authority genuinely BOUNDED — can it over-reach (impose a verdict producers didn't reach = arbitrator capture), or under-reach (rubber-stamp non-consensus as consensus)? Does the typed debate-turn artifact + the escalate-to-panel / stalemate / sustain-or-end transitions compose correctly on the workflow.v1.1 schema and compile to real daemon RPC, or is it a shape the engine can't actually run (an edge/phase/cycle the compiler rejects)? Does it deadlock under max_active_jobs / disjoint-write-scope constraints? Construct the failing case (a non-terminating debate; an arbitrator over-reach; a schema-invalid shape). If the shape doesn't terminate, the arbitrator can capture/rubber-stamp, or the shape can't compile/run, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.
jobs.title: Falsifier 1 (shape-soundness/termination lens)

jobs.objective: Read the published holder SPEC and RFC 0052. Your lens is CO-BLINDNESS EFFICACY + VALUE-vs-EXISTING-SHAPES + PROVENANCE. Attack: does lane composition ACTUALLY solve reviewer co-blindness (D095-D102), or can the committee still rubber-stamp — can same-model producers in the committee share blind spots the arbitrator can't catch; does the shape STRUCTURALLY enforce cross-model diversity + producer!=arbitrator, or merely recommend it? Does the committee shape add REAL value over the existing falsification_gate / implementation_panel / cross_examination / adjudicated_constraint_extraction shapes, or is it isomorphic to one of them (the cross_examination isomorphism trap — see prior shape-graduation lessons)? Does the latency claim hold — does first-class deliberation actually beat publish->claim->verdict round-trips, or just move the cost? Are the typed debate-turn artifacts genuinely auditable/replayable durable provenance (front-matter schema-valid, anchored), not a transcript (which the product boundary forbids capturing — D028)? Construct the failing case (a co-blind committee that rubber-stamps; an isomorphism to an existing shape; a debate turn that's really a transcript). If co-blindness isn't structurally solved, the shape duplicates an existing one, or the debate turns are transcript-not-provenance, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.
jobs.title: Falsifier 2 (co-blindness/value/provenance lens)

jobs.objective: Read only the dialogue trajectory for the RFC 0052 design (the holder SPEC and the two FALSIFIER challenges), with RFC 0052 as context. Publish the collaboration ledger verdict (accept / accept_with_findings / needs_revision / reject — a clearing verdict is accept or accept_with_findings, never `clear`). A clearing verdict REQUIRES: the committee shape provably TERMINATES (hard turn/round bound, arbitrator can declare stalemate); the arbitrator's authority is BOUNDED (no capture, no rubber-stamp); the shape COMPILES + runs on the real workflow.v1.1 schema + daemon RPC (a generatable shape, not a schema-invalid sketch); co-blindness is STRUCTURALLY solved by lane composition (cross-model diversity + producer!=arbitrator enforced, not recommended); the shape adds real value over the existing falsification_gate/implementation_panel/cross_examination/adjudicated_constraint_extraction shapes (NOT isomorphic to one); and the typed debate turns are schema-valid durable provenance, not a transcript (D028). Record per claim whether HELD and per falsifier challenge whether it STANDS or is REBUTTED. needs_revision if the shape doesn't terminate, the arbitrator can capture/rubber-stamp, the shape can't compile, co-blindness isn't structurally solved, it duplicates an existing shape, or the debate turns are transcript-not-provenance. This is the single allowed v1 revision cycle; a second needs_revision ends the gate unCleared and routes to the operator.
jobs.title: Adjudicate dialogue substance

jobs.objective: Publish the cleared, falsifiable RFC 0052 design SPEC — ONLY after the adjudicator ledger records a clearing verdict — consolidating the committee deliberation workflow shape buildable contract-first by the rfc-0052-build run: the generatable shape (jobs/edges/phases/roles compiling on workflow.v1.1 + the daemon RPC), the typed front-mattered durable debate-turn artifact_kind, the bounded arbitrator role (consensus/panel-escalation/stalemate/sustain-or-end with a hard termination bound), and the lane-composition rule that structurally solves co-blindness (cross-model diversity + producer!=arbitrator). State each as a falsifiable assertion + its test, anchored to the real shape catalog / schema / registry, and state explicitly how it differs from the existing shapes. Define the P0 slice that proves the shape end-to-end. Reference the clearing ledger. This consolidated SPEC is the single source the build run implements.
jobs.title: Commit falsification-cleared proposal

jobs.objective: Summarize the cleared collaboration gate for the RFC 0052 design: the ledger verdict, how the committee shape terminates + the arbitrator is bounded, how it compiles on the real schema, how lane composition structurally solves co-blindness, how it differs from the existing shapes, and the consolidated SPEC + named tests the rfc-0052-build run will implement.
jobs.title: Finalize collaboration run
